ipv4_only.description: If true, restrict output to IPv4 sockets only (-4 flag).

ipv6_only.description: If true, restrict output to IPv6 sockets only (-6 flag).

show_unix.description: If true, include Unix domain sockets in the output (-u flag).

show_connected.description: If true, show only connected sockets (-c flag). Default behavior shows both.

show_listening.description: If true, show only listening sockets (-l flag). Default behavior shows both.

protocol.description: Filter sockets by protocol. Valid values: 'raw', 'tcp', 'udp', 'unix'. Empty string disables filtering (-R flag).

ports.description: Comma-separated list of port numbers or ranges (e.g., '80,443,8000-9000') to filter Internet sockets by (-p flag).

process.description: Process name or PID to filter sockets by (-P flag).

user.description: Username or UID to filter sockets by (-U flag).

group.description: Group name or GID to filter sockets by (-G flag).
